title: Hiding Your PIN at the ATM Kiosk
problem: Elders in our village feel nervous standing inside town ATM centres and often ask strangers to press secret PIN keys for them.
idea: A small game that teaches elders how to use an ATM safely: cover the keypad with one hand, never tell the PIN, and never take help from strangers.

questions.q: You are typing your PIN. What should your other hand do?
questions.why: Covering the keypad stops people and hidden cameras from seeing your PIN.

questions.q: A kind stranger says, 'Tell me your PIN, I will help you'. What do you do?
options: Say NO and ask the bank guard or your family
questions.why: Never share your PIN with anyone, not even a helpful person.

questions.q: The card gets stuck in the machine. A man says, 'Type PIN again, it will come'.
options: Call the bank helpline number shown on the ATM / card
questions.why: This is a common trick. Call the official bank helpline only.

questions.q: Where should you write your PIN?
options: On the back of the card
On a paper in the wallet
questions.why: If the card is lost, a written PIN lets thieves take your money.

questions.q: After you finish, what should you check?
options: Card and cash are taken, and the screen is back to start
questions.why: Always take your card and wait for the welcome screen.

widgets.heading: ✅ My ATM Safety Checklist
widgets.intro: Tick the habits you already follow.

items.text: I go inside alone, one person at a time
I check for anything strange stuck on the card slot
items.te: కార్డ్ స్లాట్ దగ్గర వింత వస్తువు ఉందేమో చూస్తాను

items.text: I cover the keypad with my hand
I never tell my PIN to anyone
I take my card and cash before leaving
I take a family member if I feel unsure

bands.text: Super safe! You are an ATM champion.
Be careful! Learn these habits with your family.

items.title: Cover the keypad
items.text: One hand types, the other hand covers.
items.te: ఒక చేతితో టైప్ చేయండి, మరో చేతితో కప్పండి.

items.title: PIN is a secret
items.text: Not even the bank staff need your PIN.

items.title: Call 1930 if cheated
items.text: If money is stolen, call 1930 at once.

how: Ask Gemini for 5 common ATM tricks used on elders and the safe answer for each.
In Scratch, draw an ATM backdrop and a grandfather sprite.
Make question scenes with 'ask' blocks and two choices.
If the right choice is picked, play a happy sound; else show the safe rule.
Add a 'cover the keypad' animation where a hand sprite moves over the keys.
Let Dadi and Tata play the game and record Telugu voice with the Text-to-Speech extension.
prompt: I am a Class 8 student. Write 5 short ATM safety situations for village elders, each with two choices (safe and unsafe) and a one-line reason, in simple English and Telugu. Include covering the keypad, never sharing the PIN, and not taking help from strangers.
